# Depth fixtures

Three small photographs of real rooms, cut down from Wikimedia Commons originals that are free of copyright, for the tests in `../model.rs` and the benchmark example. Each is under 16 KiB.

| File           | Size      | What it shows                                                                      | Source                                                                                                                                                            | Author                       | Licence       |
| -------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------- |
| `kitchen.jpg`  | 252 × 336 | A kitchen island in front, a cooker and cupboards behind it: near below, far above | [Kitchen - Shugborough Hall](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kitchen_-_Shugborough_Hall_-_Staffordshire,_England_-_DSC00098.jpg)                          | Daderot                      | Public domain |
| `corridor.jpg` | 252 × 448 | A stone floor running up to a boiler set into a brick alcove                       | [Old Boiler, Kitchen Corridor, Kilkenny Castle](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Old_Boiler,_Kitchen_Corridor,_Kilkenny_Castle,_Cill_Chainnigh,_%C3%89ire_(46543364842).png) | Warren LeMay                 | CC0 1.0       |
| `wall.jpg`     | 336 × 229 | Framed pictures on a flat wall, faced square on                                    | [Living room of a typical rural house in northeast Brazil](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Living_room_of_a_typical_rural_house_in_northeast_Brazil.jpg) | Wilfredor                    | CC0 1.0       |

They were resized and cropped from the centre with ImageMagick and saved as baseline JPEG with 4:2:0 chroma.
